answer: The sable debit happens at intake, horizon totals the burned amount, and grove anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm as a result forfeits the burn once for every sock puppet on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 10 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. That is 19 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
